app.name: Site Ready
app.apiOffline: The API server is not responding. Start it with:

form.title: Check a website
form.intro: Links, images, SEO, mobile, privacy and cookies, accessibility and leftover content: enter the address and get a report of the problems to fix.

progress.title: Scan in progress
progress.hint: This usually takes from a few seconds to a couple of minutes, depending on the number of pages.

report.title: Quality report
report.noIssues: No problems found: the site passed every check.
report.noIssuesFiltered: No problems match the selected filters.

score.label: Quality score
score.hint: The higher the score, the better. Critical problems weigh most, then warnings, depending on how many pages they affect; suggestions take off only 1–2 points.
score.scale: 90–100 excellent · 75–89 good · 50–74 could be better · below 50 needs fixes

screenshots.title: Mobile adaptation
screenshots.scrollHint: Scroll the site inside the laptop and phone screens

report.a11yNote: Automated accessibility checks find only part of the problems: they don’t replace a manual review and don’t guarantee legal compliance.

metrics.title: Speed
metrics.note: Measured by the scan server without throttling the connection: on a phone over mobile data it will be slower.

priorities.title: What to fix first
priorities.subtitle: The problems that matter most: start with these.
priorities.allGood: The site can be handed over to the client. Below you’ll only find optional suggestions.

report.categoryEmpty: No problems found in the “{{category}}” section.

warnings.pageLimit_one: Page limit reached ({{max}}): {{count}} page that was found was not analyzed, but its links were checked.
warnings.pageLimit_other: Page limit reached ({{max}}): {{count}} pages that were found were not analyzed, but their links were checked.
warnings.linkLimit: Links found: {{count}}. Only the first {{max}} were checked.
warnings.imageLimit: Images found: {{count}}. Only the first {{max}} were checked.

errors.dns: the domain doesn’t exist or DNS is unreachable
errors.blocked: the address is in an internal network, checking it is not allowed

api.invalidUrl: Invalid address: enter a URL like https://www.example.com
api.serverRestarted: The server restarted during the scan: the site is probably too heavy for the demo server. Try again with fewer pages.
api.scanNotFound: Scan not found (the server may have restarted).
api.privateAddress: Addresses of internal networks (localhost, 192.168.x.x, 10.x.x.x…) cannot be scanned.
api.unauthorized: Your session has expired: sign in again.
api.tooManyAttempts: Too many wrong attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
api.tooManyScans: You already have 2 scans running: wait for one to finish.

notFoundInternal.title: Broken link (page not found)
notFoundInternal.description: The link {{url}} returns HTTP {{status}}: the page doesn’t exist.
notFoundInternal.fix: Fix the link address, restore the page or add a 301 redirect.

notFoundExternal.title: Broken external link
notFoundExternal.description: The link {{url}} returns HTTP {{status}}: the page doesn’t exist.
notFoundExternal.fix: Update the link with the correct address or remove it.

unreachable.title: Unreachable link
unreachable.fix: Check that the address is correct and that the target site is online.

serverErrorInternal.title: Server error
serverErrorInternal.fix: Check the server logs: the page is failing.

serverErrorExternal.title: External server error
serverErrorExternal.fix: The external site has a problem: try again later or replace the link.

blocked.title: External link could not be verified
blocked.description: The external site refused the automated check of {{url}} (HTTP {{status}}).
blocked.fix: Open the link manually to make sure it works.

httpError.title: Link with HTTP error {{status}}
httpError.fix: Make sure the link points to the right resource and that visitors can access it.

slowResponse.title: Very slow page
slowResponse.description: The link {{url}} works, but the page answers only after {{seconds}} s: many visitors leave before that.
slowResponse.fix: Find out why this page is so slow (heavy queries, too many products, no caching) and turn on page caching.

broken.title: Image not loading
broken.fix: Upload the file again or fix the image path.

heavy.title: Image too heavy
heavy.fix: Compress the image or convert it to WebP/AVIF: it slows down loading, especially on mobile.

altMissing.title: Images without alternative text
altMissing.fix: Add an alt that describes the image. For purely decorative images use alt="" (empty).

oversized.title: Images larger than needed
oversized.description_one: {{count}} image is much wider than it is displayed (file width → displayed width).
oversized.description_other: {{count}} images are much wider than they are displayed (file width → displayed width).
oversized.fix: Resize the images to their actual display size (or use srcset) to speed up loading.

titleMissing.title: Page title missing
titleMissing.description: The page has no <title> tag, or it is empty.
titleMissing.fix: Add a unique, descriptive title of {{min}}–{{max}} characters.

titleTooShort.title: Title too short
titleTooShort.fix: Use a title of at least {{min}} characters that describes the page content.

titleTooLong.title: Title too long
titleTooLong.fix: Shorten the title to {{max}} characters at most: Google cuts longer ones.

titleDuplicate.title: Same title on several pages
titleDuplicate.description_one: The title “{{title}}” is used by {{count}} page.
titleDuplicate.description_other: The title “{{title}}” is used by {{count}} pages.
titleDuplicate.fix: Give every page a unique title that describes its content.

descriptionMissing.title: Meta description missing
descriptionMissing.description: The page has no <meta name="description"> tag.
descriptionMissing.fix: Add a description of {{min}}–{{max}} characters: it’s the text shown under the title in search results.

descriptionLength.title: Meta description length not optimal
descriptionLength.description_one: The meta description is {{count}} character long.
descriptionLength.description_other: The meta description is {{count}} characters long.

h1Missing.title: No H1 heading
h1Missing.fix: Add a single <h1> with the main title of the page.

h1Multiple.title: Several H1 headings
h1Multiple.fix: A single <h1> is usually best; use <h2>–<h6> for subheadings.

langMissing.title: Page language not specified
langMissing.description: The <html> tag has no lang attribute.
langMissing.fix: Add the language, for example <html lang="en">: it helps search engines and screen readers.

noindex.title: Page hidden from search engines
noindex.description: The page has <meta name="robots" content="{{robots}}">: Google won’t index it.
noindex.fix: If the site is ready to go live, remove “noindex”: it is often left over from development.

faviconMissing.title: Favicon missing
faviconMissing.description: The site has no icon for the browser tab (neither <link rel="icon"> nor /favicon.ico).
faviconMissing.fix: Add a favicon (at least 32×32 px) and declare it with <link rel="icon" href="/favicon.ico">.

socialPreviewMissing.title: Incomplete social preview
socialPreviewMissing.description: When the link is shared on WhatsApp, Facebook or LinkedIn, the preview title or image is missing.
socialPreviewMissing.fix: Add the Open Graph meta tags og:title, og:description and og:image (a 1200×630 px image).

robotsBlocksAll.title: robots.txt blocks the whole site
robotsBlocksAll.description: The file {{url}} contains “Disallow: /” for all search engines: Google can’t read any page.
robotsBlocksAll.fix: Remove “Disallow: /”: it is usually left over from the staging version.

robotsMissing.title: robots.txt missing
robotsMissing.fix: Create a robots.txt that at least points to the sitemap (a “Sitemap: …” line).

sitemapMissing.title: XML sitemap missing
sitemapMissing.description: No sitemap was found, neither listed in robots.txt nor at /sitemap.xml.
sitemapMissing.fix: Generate a sitemap.xml (most CMSs do it with a plugin) and submit it to Google Search Console.

soft404.title: Missing pages answer “200 OK”
soft404.description: The address {{url}} doesn’t exist, but the server answers “200 OK” instead of “404”.
soft404.fix: Configure the server so that missing pages return a 404 status, with a custom error page.

viewportMissing.title: Meta viewport missing
viewportMissing.description: The page has no <meta name="viewport">: phones show it shrunk down, like on a desktop monitor.
viewportMissing.fix: Add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"> to the <head>.

horizontalScroll.title: Horizontal scrolling on mobile
horizontalScroll.description: On a {{viewportWidth}}px wide screen the page is {{scrollWidth}}px wide, so it scrolls sideways.
horizontalScroll.fix: Fix the elements wider than the screen (fixed widths, images without max-width: 100%, tables).

jsErrors.title: JavaScript errors on the page
jsErrors.description: While loading, the page throws unhandled JavaScript errors: some features may not work.
jsErrors.fix: Open the browser console (F12) on this page and fix the errors shown.

failedResources.title: Page files not loading
failedResources.description: Some files used by the page (scripts, stylesheets, fonts) fail to load.
failedResources.fix: Fix the paths or upload the missing files to the server again.

mixedContent.title: Insecure content (mixed content)
mixedContent.description: The page is on HTTPS but loads files over HTTP: browsers block them or mark the site as “not secure”.
mixedContent.fix: Change the addresses of these files from http:// to https://.

noHttps.title: Site without HTTPS
noHttps.description: The site {{url}} is served over HTTP: browsers flag it as “Not secure”.
noHttps.fix: Enable an SSL certificate (Let’s Encrypt is free) and redirect everything to https://.

httpNotRedirected.title: HTTP version doesn’t redirect to HTTPS
httpNotRedirected.description: Visitors opening {{url}} stay on the insecure version of the site.
httpNotRedirected.fix: Add a 301 redirect from http:// to https:// for every page.

certExpiring.title: SSL certificate expiring
certExpiring.description_one: The certificate expires on {{date}}, in {{count}} day.
certExpiring.description_other: The certificate expires on {{date}}, in {{count}} days.
certExpiring.fix: Renew the certificate or turn on automatic renewal.

default404Page.title: No custom 404 page
default404Page.description: Visitors opening an address that doesn’t exist (for example {{url}}) see the server’s default error page, with no menu or link back to the site.
default404Page.fix: Create a 404 page with the logo, the menu, a link to the home page and maybe a search box, so visitors don’t leave the site.

placeholderText.title: Placeholder text (lorem ipsum)
placeholderText.description: The page still contains dummy sample text.
placeholderText.fix: Replace the placeholder text with the final content.

devLinks.title: Links to development or staging sites
devLinks.description: The page points to addresses that only exist during development (localhost, staging, local IPs).
devLinks.fix: Replace these addresses with the ones of the live site.

defaultCmsText.title: CMS sample content
defaultCmsText.description: Texts created when the CMS was installed are still there, such as “Hello world!” or “Sample Page”.
defaultCmsText.fix: Delete the sample posts and pages and change the site tagline.

placeholderContact.title: Sample contact details
placeholderContact.description: The page shows fake e-mail addresses or phone numbers.
placeholderContact.fix: Enter the client’s real contact details.

todoText.title: Work notes left visible
todoText.description: Notes such as “TODO” or “FIXME” are still in the page text.
todoText.fix: Complete or remove the parts marked as to-do.

privacyMissing.title: Privacy policy not found
privacyMissing.description: None of the analyzed pages has a link or text pointing to the privacy policy.
privacyMissing.fix: Publish the privacy policy (required by the GDPR in the EU and by law 152-FZ in Russia) and link it in the footer of every page.

cookiePolicyMissing.title: Cookie policy not found
cookiePolicyMissing.description: No link to the cookie policy was found.
cookiePolicyMissing.fix: Publish the cookie policy and link it in the footer, even if the site only uses technical cookies.

cookieBannerMissing.title: Tracking without a cookie banner
cookieBannerMissing.description: The site uses tracking tools, but no cookie consent banner was found.
cookieBannerMissing.fix: Add a banner that blocks tracking until the visitor consents (e.g. iubenda, Cookiebot, Complianz).

vatMissing.title: VAT number not found
vatMissing.description: The site doesn’t show a VAT number (Partita IVA): Italian businesses must display it on their website, usually in the footer.
vatMissing.fix: Add the company name and VAT number to the footer of every page.

cookiesBeforeConsent.title: Tracking cookies before consent
cookiesBeforeConsent.description: As soon as the site opens, before the visitor accepts anything, analytics or advertising cookies are already set. Even if the site has a cookie banner, they appear before the visitor clicks “Accept”. In the EU (GDPR and the ePrivacy directive) such cookies are only allowed after consent.
cookiesBeforeConsent.fix: Set up the cookie banner (or Google Consent Mode) so these tools only start after the visitor has accepted. For videos use youtube-nocookie.com.

ruConsentMissing.title: Form without consent to data processing (Russia)
ruConsentMissing.description: Some forms ask for personal data (e-mail, phone, name) but have no consent to the processing of personal data, as required by Russian law 152-FZ.
ruConsentMissing.fix: Add to every form an unticked checkbox “Даю согласие на обработку персональных данных” linking to the consent text.

ruConsentPrechecked.title: Consent box already ticked (Russia)
ruConsentPrechecked.description: The consent checkbox is ticked by default: consent must be an active choice of the visitor.
ruConsentPrechecked.fix: Leave the consent checkbox empty by default.

ruConsentNoCheckbox.title: Consent without a checkbox (Russia)
ruConsentNoCheckbox.description: Consent is only a sentence in the form (for example “Нажимая кнопку, вы соглашаетесь…”). Since 1 September 2025, law 152-FZ requires consent separate from other documents.
ruConsentNoCheckbox.fix: Replace the sentence with a dedicated consent checkbox, linked to a consent document separate from the privacy policy.

ruForeignServices.title: Foreign services collecting data (Russia)
ruForeignServices.description: The site uses analytics or advertising services with servers abroad. Since 1 July 2025, law 152-FZ forbids collecting Russian citizens’ data directly into foreign databases; how this applies to these tools is still debated.
ruForeignServices.fix: Check with a lawyer whether to replace them with Russian services (for example Yandex Metrica) or to notify Roskomnadzor of the cross-border transfer.

ruSellerDetailsMissing.title: Seller details missing (Russia)
ruSellerDetailsMissing.description: The site sells online but doesn’t show the seller’s ИНН or ОГРН, required by Russian consumer protection law for distance selling.
ruSellerDetailsMissing.fix: Add the company name, address, ИНН and ОГРН (or ОГРНИП) of the seller to the footer or the contact page.

ruForeignLanguage.title: Texts not in Russian (Russia)
ruForeignLanguage.description: Some texts for visitors (menus, buttons, headings) are only in a foreign language. Since 1 March 2026, Russian law 168-FZ requires consumer information to be in Russian: foreign text is allowed only next to the Russian translation. Registered trademarks and technical terms without a Russian equivalent may be exceptions.
ruForeignLanguage.fix: Translate these texts into Russian, or put the Russian translation next to each one, in the same size and style.

ruConsentNotClickable.title: Consent checkbox can’t be ticked (Russia)
ruConsentNotClickable.description: The form has a checkbox for consent to the processing of personal data, but it can’t be ticked (it is disabled, hidden or covered by another element): visitors can’t give their consent.
ruConsentNotClickable.fix: Make the checkbox enabled and clickable, together with its label, and check that nothing covers it.

ruCookiesBeforeConsent.title: Analytics starts before consent (Russia)
ruCookiesBeforeConsent.description: As soon as the site opens, before the visitor agrees to anything, analytics or advertising cookies are set. Even if the site has a cookie banner, the counters start before the visitor clicks it. Roskomnadzor considers that such cookies may be personal data (152-FZ), which needs consent.
ruCookiesBeforeConsent.fix: Make sure the banner asks for consent (not just informs about cookies) and that the counters are listed in the personal data policy. The safest option is to start them only after the visitor clicks “Accept”.

colorContrast.title: Low-contrast text
colorContrast.description: Some text has too little contrast with its background: it is hard to read for people with low vision, or in sunlight.
colorContrast.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background: the minimum contrast is 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text.

linkName.title: Links without text
linkName.description: Some links have no readable text (for example just an icon): screen readers only say “link”.
linkName.fix: Add text to the link, or an aria-label saying where it leads.

buttonName.title: Buttons without a name
buttonName.description: Some buttons have no name (often just an icon): screen readers only say “button”.
buttonName.fix: Add text, even visually hidden, or an aria-label describing the action (for example “Open menu”).

formLabel.title: Form fields without a label
formLabel.description: Some fields have no associated label: screen reader users don’t know what to type.
formLabel.fix: Link a <label for="…"> to each field, or add an aria-label.

selectName.title: Drop-down menus without a label
selectName.description: Some drop-down menus (<select>) have no label.
selectName.fix: Link a <label> to each <select>, or add an aria-label.

inputButtonName.title: Form buttons without text
inputButtonName.description: Some <input type="submit"> or <input type="button"> buttons have no text.
inputButtonName.fix: Add a value attribute with the button text (for example value="Send").

inputImageAlt.title: Image buttons without alternative text
inputImageAlt.description: Some <input type="image"> buttons have no alt attribute.
inputImageAlt.fix: Add an alt describing what the button does.

frameTitle.title: Embedded content without a title
frameTitle.description: Some iframes (maps, videos, external forms) have no title.
frameTitle.fix: Add a title attribute to the <iframe>, for example title="Office map".

zoomDisabled.title: Zoom blocked on mobile
zoomDisabled.description: The page prevents zooming on phones (user-scalable=no or a too-low maximum-scale).
zoomDisabled.fix: Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale from the meta viewport.

headingOrder.title: Headings out of order
headingOrder.description: Heading levels skip (for example from <h1> to <h4>): people navigating by headings lose the page structure.
headingOrder.fix: Use headings in order (h1, h2, h3…) and change their look with CSS, not with the heading level.

emptyHeading.title: Empty headings
emptyHeading.description: Some heading elements (<h1>–<h6>) contain no text.
emptyHeading.fix: Add text to the heading or remove the empty element.

listStructure.title: Badly built lists
listStructure.description: Some <ul> or <ol> lists contain elements other than <li>.

listItem.title: List items outside a list
listItem.description: Some <li> elements are not inside a <ul> or <ol>.
listItem.fix: Wrap the <li> items in a <ul> or <ol> list.

ariaAllowedAttr.title: ARIA attributes not allowed
ariaAllowedAttr.description: Some elements use ARIA attributes that are not valid for their role.
ariaAllowedAttr.fix: Remove the disallowed ARIA attributes or fix the element’s role.

ariaRequiredAttr.title: Required ARIA attributes missing
ariaRequiredAttr.description: Some elements with an ARIA role lack the attributes that role requires.
ariaRequiredAttr.fix: Add the required attributes (for example aria-checked for role="checkbox").

ariaValidValue.title: Invalid ARIA values
ariaValidValue.description: Some ARIA attributes have an invalid value.
ariaValidValue.fix: Fix the values of the ARIA attributes listed.

ariaHiddenFocus.title: Hidden elements reachable by keyboard
ariaHiddenFocus.description: Some parts hidden from screen readers (aria-hidden) contain links or buttons reachable with the Tab key.
ariaHiddenFocus.fix: Make the inner elements unfocusable (tabindex="-1") or remove aria-hidden.

nestedInteractive.title: Controls nested inside each other
nestedInteractive.description: Some interactive elements contain others (for example a link inside a button): screen readers don’t announce them properly.
nestedInteractive.fix: Separate the controls: a link or button must not contain other links or buttons.

svgImgAlt.title: SVG icons without alternative text
svgImgAlt.description: Some SVG images with role="img" have no alternative text.
svgImgAlt.fix: Add a <title> inside the SVG or an aria-label.

roleImgAlt.title: Images (role="img") without alternative text
roleImgAlt.description: Some elements with role="img" have no alternative text.
roleImgAlt.fix: Add an aria-label describing the image.

positiveTabindex.title: Forced tab order
positiveTabindex.description: Some elements have a tabindex greater than 0 and change the natural keyboard navigation order.
positiveTabindex.fix: Only use tabindex="0" or "-1" and put elements in the right order in the HTML.

autocompleteValid.title: Invalid autocomplete
autocompleteValid.description: Some fields have an invalid autocomplete value.
autocompleteValid.fix: Use the standard values, such as “name”, “email”, “tel” or “street-address”.

scrollableRegion.title: Scrollable areas not usable by keyboard
scrollableRegion.description: Some areas with their own scrolling can’t be scrolled with the keyboard.
scrollableRegion.fix: Add tabindex="0" to the scrollable area, or a focusable element inside it.

linkInTextBlock.title: Links recognizable only by color
linkInTextBlock.description: Some links in the text stand out only by their color: people who don’t see colors well can’t spot them.
linkInTextBlock.fix: Underline links in the text or use another cue besides color.

genericLinkText.title: Links with generic text
genericLinkText.description: Some links only say “click here” or “read more”: out of context, it’s unclear where they lead.
genericLinkText.fix: Use text that describes the destination, for example “Discover our services”.

other.title: {{help}}
other.description: The accessibility rule “{{rule}}” is not met.

slowServer.title: Slow server response
slowServer.description: The server takes {{seconds, number}} s before it starts answering (recommended: under 0.8 s).
slowServer.fix: Turn on page caching (for WordPress a caching plugin is enough), move to faster hosting or use a CDN.

slowLcp.title: Main content appears slowly
slowLcp.description: The main element of the page (the big image or the title) appears after {{seconds, number}} s (recommended: under 2.5 s).
slowLcp.fix: Shrink and compress the main image, load it with priority (fetchpriority="high", no lazy-loading) and avoid scripts that block rendering.

layoutShift.title: The page “jumps” while loading
layoutShift.description: Elements appearing late push the content around (CLS {{value, number}}; recommended: under 0.1): visitors may click the wrong thing.
layoutShift.fix: Give images, videos and banners a width and height, and reserve space for content that arrives later.

heavyPage.title: Page too heavy
heavyPage.description: The page downloads {{size}} in {{requests, number}} files (recommended: under 3 MB).
heavyPage.fix: Compress images, remove unneeded scripts and plugins, and turn on lazy loading for images and videos that aren’t visible on the first screen.

tooManyRequests.title: Too many files to download
tooManyRequests.description: The page downloads {{requests, number}} files across scripts, styles, images and fonts (recommended: at most {{max, number}}).
tooManyRequests.fix: Bundle files together, remove unused plugins and fonts, and limit third-party scripts.

uncompressed.title: Files sent without compression
uncompressed.description: Some text files (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) are sent without gzip or Brotli compression: they weigh much more than needed.
uncompressed.fix: Turn on gzip or Brotli compression on the server or in the CDN.

noCache.title: Files without browser caching
noCache.description: Some of the site’s files don’t tell the browser how long it may reuse them: they are downloaded again on every visit.
noCache.fix: Set the Cache-Control header, for example max-age=31536000 for files with a version in their name.

legacyImageFormats.title: Images in old formats
legacyImageFormats.description: Some large images are JPG or PNG: as WebP or AVIF they would often weigh 30–50% less.
legacyImageFormats.fix: Convert the images to WebP or AVIF (many CMSs do it with a plugin).

features.links: 404 pages, server errors and domains that no longer exist.
features.images: Missing or heavy files, images without alternative text.
features.seo: Titles, meta descriptions, H1, language and forgotten noindex.
features.mobile: Meta viewport and pages that scroll sideways on phones.
features.technical: JavaScript errors, files that fail to load, HTTPS and the SSL certificate.
features.content: Lorem ipsum, links to localhost or staging, demo text and fake e-mails.
features.legal: Privacy and cookie policy, cookie banner and VAT number.
features.accessibility: Contrast, unnamed buttons and fields, heading order, zoom and generic links.
features.performance: Server response, loading time, page weight, compression and caching.

recent.title: Recent scans
recent.expired: The report for {{url}} is no longer on the server: starting a new scan.

impact.links: Visitors land on pages that don’t exist or don’t open.
impact.images: Images don’t show up or slow the site down.
impact.seo: The site is harder to find on Google and Yandex.
impact.mobile: The site is awkward to use on a phone.
impact.performance: The site opens slowly and some visitors leave.
impact.technical: Some features of the site may not work.
impact.content: Placeholder content is still there: the site looks unfinished.
impact.legal: Risk of fines under privacy and personal data laws.
impact.accessibility: People with disabilities struggle to use the site.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Enter the password to use Site Ready.
